analysis.summary: A survey comparing how mutation testing is applied across three domains -- large language models, REST APIs and database engines -- based on 30 peer-reviewed studies. It compares mutation operator design, tool support and evaluation methods in each, reporting that LLM work is early-stage, REST API work benefits from adaptive schema-based tools, and database engine work uses grammar- and query-plan-guided mutation.
analysis.narrative: SQLancer appears as one of the representative database engine tools surveyed, and query-plan-guided mutation -- SQLancer's QPG -- is named as a contribution of that domain.
